zh: 端到端通道不带 `--scenario` 时走 `packages/contracts/src/timing.ts` 那张表里除停放的两个统计场景之外的全部条目，新加入表的场景默认进入云端判定，停放名单与场景表对不上时运行直接终止。
en: The end-to-end lane without `--scenario` walks every entry of the table in `packages/contracts/src/timing.ts` but the two parked statistics scenarios, so a scenario added to the table is judged in the cloud by default, and a parked name the table does not hold stops the run.
